query:
SELECT
            i.grantee_agent_id AS "agent_id!",
            a.slug AS "agent_slug!",
            COUNT(*) AS "count!"
        FROM relay_invocations i
        JOIN agents a ON a.id = i.grantee_agent_id
        WHERE i.api_key_id = $1
          AND i.created_at >= $2
          AND i.created_at < $3
        GROUP BY i.grantee_agent_id, a.slug
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 20
